body:
#: 13
Decision: Farm: "Farm Lane", animals and things to do
Notes: One of the 8 roads that end at the town's edge continues into a short Farm Lane through cleared forest (not the east road: it leads to the beach gate). Animals: horses, cows, sheep, pigs, chickens. Cows are farm animals only, never pets (Karolis 29 Oct). Feed and pet them, ride a horse around the farm, collect eggs and milk and sell them at the Market. A farm job from Rosie later
title: Pet decision 13: Farm: "Farm Lane", animals and things to do
